subject.title: feat(plugins): support per-agent plugin installation with --agent flag

question: Should OpenClaw accept a partial storage-only per-agent plugin install contract now, or require the full per-agent plugin lifecycle and security design from the canonical feature issue before any merge?
rationale: This PR adds a public CLI flag and persistent install metadata shape that affect plugin code execution, provenance, update, uninstall, and agent isolation semantics; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary safely.

options.title: Require Full Lifecycle Contract
options.body: Keep this PR open for redesign until install, uninstall, update, registry/provenance, runtime discovery, security policy, docs, and tests agree on the same per-agent contract.

options.title: Narrow Or Close This Branch
options.body: Use the linked feature issue for design and ask for a new narrower PR once maintainers choose the durable contract.

options.title: Accept Storage-Only Risk
options.body: Merge the partial install-record and install-root change while explicitly owning the incomplete uninstall/runtime/security follow-up risk.

recommendation.title: Require Full Lifecycle Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open for redesign until install, uninstall, update, registry/provenance, runtime discovery, security policy, docs, and tests agree on the same per-agent contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on managed plugin install records, recovery, and uninstall behavior in the affected files.
